dcat_keyword_sm: Urban forest; priority planting; canopy cover
dct_description_sm: This layer indicates the top priority planting areas for Etobicoke Creek watershed based on eco-hydrological and social criteria.The layer identifies two broad tiers of priority planting areas: Tier 1 and Tier 2.Tier 1: These are areas that are both eco-hydrological priorities and social priorities.Tier 2: These are areas that are only eco-hydrolgocical priorities.Tiers are also categorized into a and b. "a" represents the top 10 polygons in terms of the number of trees that can be planted within that tier, while "b" is the remaining polygons within that tier.Social priorities are determined by heat vulnerability, Peel PCCP planting priorities and Brampton no mow areas.Eco-hydrological priorities are determined by low canopy cover in subwatershed, occuring with a contributing area to the NHS, distance to the water  resource system, and within an ecologically significant groundwater recharge area.
